text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day the students get their
race times
officially measured.
Everyone's brimming with
excitement, as
well as anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I did it! I beat my time! It's all thanks to
you,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I knew you had it in you! Keep up the
great work!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ Listen and be amazed! I
crushed my
previous best!
choice_data_list: Good work. How were your measurements?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Not that that's a surprise or anything. I am always number one, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's not what I meant to say. I
mean...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer... I-I mean, obviously,
I'm
perfect and all, but...
choice_data_list: Your daily efforts really paid off.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I guess I'm saying... It wasn't all thanks to me, so...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just... keep up the good work, okay?!
Y-you
better not slack off!
